query:
package.json lists @eleven-labs/nest-profiler in dependencies, and app.module.ts registers the profiler with the ConditionalModule install:
  ConditionalModule.registerWhen(ProfilingModule, isProfilerEnabled),
The app just added @nestjs/cache-manager and CacheModule.register({ isGlobal: true }).

User: Add cache profiling.
expected_behavior: Confirm the base profiler is already set up and note the existing install is dependencies + ConditionalModule. Install @eleven-labs/nest-profiler-cache WITHOUT -D (same flag as the core). Register CacheCollectorModule.forRoot() in the ProfilingModule bundle — the existing gate covers it — do not introduce a different enable pattern.

query:
app.module.ts registers the profiler with the enabled flag (dependencies install, no @nestjs/config):
  ProfilerModule.forRoot({ isGlobal: true, enabled: process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production' }),
The app uses mongoose + @nestjs/mongoose with MongooseModule.forRoot(...).

User: Add MongoDB query profiling.
expected_behavior: Confirm the base setup and note the existing strategy is the enabled flag. Install @eleven-labs/nest-profiler-mongoose (no -D, same flag as the core) and register MongooseCollectorModule.forRoot({ slowThreshold: 100 }) (slowThreshold, NOT slowQueryThreshold), optionally MongooseSchemaCollectorModule for the model panel. Must MATCH the enabled flag — do NOT introduce ConditionalModule.registerWhen (that would be a second, inconsistent pattern).

query:
package.json has @nestjs/common, @nestjs/core, typeorm, @nestjs/typeorm but NO @eleven-labs/nest-profiler dependency, and no ProfilerModule anywhere in the codebase.

User: Add the TypeORM profiler collector.
expected_behavior: Detect that the core profiler is NOT installed/configured yet. Should NOT install and wire the collector in isolation. Redirect the user to the setup-nest-profiler skill (which installs the core and can add collectors in the same pass). A collector alone will not work without the core ProfilerModule.

query:
@eleven-labs/nest-profiler is in devDependencies and loaded by main-dev.ts through AppDevModule + ProfilingModule. The app added @golevelup/nestjs-rabbitmq and amqplib and consumes messages via @RabbitSubscribe.

User: Add RabbitMQ message profiling.
expected_behavior: Confirm base setup (dev-dependency install). Install '<pm> add -D @eleven-labs/nest-profiler-rabbitmq' (the broker libraries stay production dependencies) and register RabbitMqCollectorModule.forRoot() (plus RabbitMqPublishCollectorModule.forRoot() for published messages) in the ProfilingModule bundle — not in the production feature module, no gate. Verify by publishing/consuming a message with the dev entry and checking the RabbitMQ panel.

query:
The profiler is already set up. The app uses ioredis directly for a custom pub/sub channel (no @nestjs/cache-manager, no @golevelup/nestjs-rabbitmq).

User: Add a collector to profile my Redis pub/sub messages.
expected_behavior: Recognize there is NO dedicated @eleven-labs/nest-profiler-* collector for raw ioredis pub/sub — do not invent a package. Clarify honestly. May suggest alternatives: the cache collector if the app used @nestjs/cache-manager with a Redis store, otherwise building a custom collector / context adapter (out of scope for this skill).
